decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records cross-user consistency for bullet sizes and spacing, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Cross-user rendering consistency for bullet sizes and spacing does not change Tab-driven sublevel creation or hierarchy behavior.
The source concerns consistent rendering of bullet visuals across users, not hard-return spacing in continuous paragraph text.
The decision does not alter the behavior whereby pressing Enter creates a new bullet.
Cross-user consistency of graphic bullet sizes and spacing does not change multi-digit numbered-list alignment.
The source does not affect the extra border or horizontal-line behavior when inserting Board Meeting rows.
Bullet rendering consistency does not change the Guidance template's fixed-margin or pencil-icon visibility requirements.
The source concerns bullet size and spacing consistency, not which theme colors are included or offered.
The source does not change alignment among the Board Meeting fields.
Cross-user rendering of bullet visuals has no necessary effect on the reusable calendar date control.
The source does not change how interactive-field placeholder text clears on activation.
Bullet size and spacing consistency across users does not alter text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
